source.custom: Backgrounds: feat only, no ASI (2026-11-06 ruling).

system.description: Your natural authority makes you a rallying point in social situations. Allies who can see or hear you during a social encounter gain a +1 bonus to their Charisma-based checks. When you spend at least 10 minutes speaking with a crowd or group, they treat you as a trusted figure rather than a stranger for the duration of that interaction.
